/-!
# Convergence of the actual forward coefficient energy

Full Weil positivity supplies the exact logarithmic moment ceiling. The
monotone primitive argument turns it into a limit, without an additional
regularity, coefficient sign, or convergence premise.

open Filter Topology

namespace RHTower.WeilSingularArithmetic

/-- The critical weighted energy has an actual finite limit. -/
theorem exists_forwardCoeff_energy_limit {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ Tendsto (fun N : ℕ =>
      (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, ‖forwardCoeff lam n‖ ^ 2 / n) / Real.log N)
        atTop (𝓝 K) := by
  obtain ⟨C, _, hC⟩ := exists_forwardCoeff_log_moment_le hW
  apply LogMoment.exists_mass_limit (w := fun n => ‖forwardCoeff lam n‖ ^ 2 / n)
    (C := C) (fun n => div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (Nat.cast_nonneg n))
  intro N hN
  simpa only [LogMoment.moment, LogMoment.mass, ← mul_div_assoc] using hC N hN

/-!
# Actual parity residue is charged to actual source variance

The odd/full ratio need not be assumed canonical. Its deviation from one
half is bounded by the residual logarithmic variance of the source.
-/

open Complex Filter Topology Set
noncomputable section
namespace RHTower.WeilSingularArithmetic
open WeilWorkSettledPhase

/-- The actual forward series has the residue supplied by its completion. -/
theorem forward_source_residue {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) :
    Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => ((s : ℂ) - 1) * LSeries (sourceCoeff lam) (s : ℂ))
      (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 (sourceCompletion hW 1)) := by
  obtain ⟨R, hRd, hReq, _⟩ := exists_forward_regularPart hW
  have hRc : ContinuousAt R (1 : ℂ) :=
    (hRd.differentiableAt ((isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_re).mem_nhds
      (by norm_num : (1 / 2 : ℝ) < (1 : ℂ).re))).continuousAt
  have hreal : Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => (s : ℂ)) (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 1) :=
    (Complex.continuous_ofReal.tendsto 1).mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  have ht := ((hreal.sub_const 1).mul (hRc.tendsto.comp hreal)).add_const
    (sourceCompletion hW 1)
  simp only [sub_self, zero_mul, zero_add] at ht
  apply ht.congr'
  filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with s hs
  have hs1 : (s : ℂ) - 1 ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have := congr_arg Complex.re h
    simp only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.one_re, Complex.zero_re] at this
    change 1 < s at hs
    linarith
  simp only [Function.comp_apply]
  rw [hReq (s : ℂ) hs]
  field_simp [hs1]
  ring

private theorem alternating_summable {f : ℕ → ℂ} {s : ℂ}
    (hf : LSeriesSummable f s) : LSeriesSummable (fun n => f n * (-1 : ℂ) ^ n) s := by
  rw [alternating_eq_sub_twice_oddPart]
  exact hf.sub ((summable_oddPart hf).smul 2)

private theorem alternating_LSeries {f : ℕ → ℂ} {s : ℂ}
    (hf : LSeriesSummable f s) :
    LSeries (fun n => f n * (-1 : ℂ) ^ n) s =
      LSeries f s - 2 * LSeries (oddPart f) s := by
  rw [alternating_eq_sub_twice_oddPart,
    LSeries_sub hf ((summable_oddPart hf).smul 2), LSeries_smul]

private theorem alternating_one_residue_zero :
    Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => ((s : ℂ) - 1) * LSeries (fun n => (-1 : ℂ) ^ n) (s : ℂ))
      (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 0) := by
  have hreal : Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => (s : ℂ)) (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 1) :=
    (Complex.continuous_ofReal.tendsto 1).mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  have hpow := hreal.neg.const_cpow (a := (2 : ℂ)) (Or.inl (by norm_num))
  have hz : Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => ((s : ℂ) - 1) * riemannZeta (s : ℂ))
      (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 1) := by
    have hc : Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => (s : ℂ)) (𝓝[>] 1)
        (𝓝[{s : ℂ | 1 < s.re}] 1) :=
      continuous_ofReal.continuousWithinAt.tendsto_nhdsWithin (fun _ _ => by simp_all)
    apply (tendsto_sub_mul_tsum_nat_cpow.comp hc).congr'
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with s hs
    simp only [Function.comp_apply]
    rw [zeta_eq_tsum_one_div_nat_cpow (s := (s : ℂ)) hs]
  have ht := ((hpow.const_sub 1).const_mul 2).const_sub 1 |>.mul hz
  norm_num [Complex.cpow_neg_one] at ht
  apply ht.congr'
  filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with s hs
  have ha := alternating_LSeries (s := (s : ℂ))
    (LSeriesSummable_one_iff.mpr (show 1 < (s : ℂ).re from hs))
  simp only [Pi.one_apply, one_mul] at ha
  rw [ha, LSeries_oddPart_one (s := (s : ℂ)) hs,
    LSeries_one_eq_riemannZeta (s := (s : ℂ)) hs]
  ring

/-- Full positivity alone supplies the actual variance and actual positive
odd/full ratio, with their sharp parity-energy inequality. -/
theorem exists_forward_parity_variance {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) :
    ∃ V r : ℝ, 0 ≤ V ∧ 0 < r ∧
      Tendsto (fun N : ℕ =>
        (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, ‖forwardCoeff lam n - sourceCompletion hW 1‖ ^ 2 / n) /
          Real.log N) atTop (𝓝 V) ∧
      Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => LSeries (oddPart (sourceCoeff lam)) (s : ℂ) /
        LSeries (sourceCoeff lam) (s : ℂ)) (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 (r : ℂ)) ∧
      ‖sourceCompletion hW 1‖ ^ 2 * (2 * r - 1) ^ 2 ≤ V := by
  obtain ⟨_, V, _, hV0, _, _, hV⟩ := exists_forwardCoeff_energy_variance hW
  obtain ⟨r, _, _, hr, _, _, hRatio, _⟩ := exists_odd_source_ratio_limit hW
  refine ⟨V, r, hV0, hr, hV, hRatio, ?_⟩
  let B : ℂ := sourceCompletion hW 1
  let f : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => (sourceCoeff lam n - B) * (-1 : ℂ) ^ n
  have hnorm (n : ℕ) : ‖f n‖ = ‖forwardCoeff lam n - B‖ := by
    simp [f, norm_pow, forwardCoeff_eq_sourceCoeff]
  have hE : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ =>
      weightPartialSum (fun n => ‖f n‖ ^ 2 / n) N / Real.log N) atTop (𝓝 V) := by
    apply hV.congr
    intro N
    congr 1
    unfold weightPartialSum
    simp only [hnorm]
    apply Finset.sum_subset
    · intro n hn
      simp only [Finset.mem_Icc] at hn ⊢
      omega
    · intro n hn hn'
      have hn0 : n = 0 := by
        simp only [Finset.mem_Icc] at hn hn'
        omega
      simp [hn0]

/-!
# The actual residue is the logarithmic first mean

The centered ordinary Dirichlet convergence already proved for the source
pays both coordinates of the logarithmic mean. No mean is postulated.
-/

open Complex Filter Topology
open GaloisForLFunctions.RHTower

noncomputable section

namespace RHTower.WeilSingularArithmetic

private theorem sum_Icc_one_eq_range {A : Type*} [AddCommMonoid A]
    (f : ℕ → A) (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, f n = ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, f (n + 1) := by
  induction N with
  | zero => simp
  | succ N ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega), Finset.sum_range_succ, ih]

/-- The two existing definitions use exactly the same truncated logarithm. -/
theorem forwardCoeff_eq_sourceCoeff (lam : ℕ → ℝ) :
    forwardCoeff lam = WeilWorkSettledPhase.sourceCoeff lam := by
  unfold forwardCoeff WeilWorkSettledPhase.sourceCoeff
  congr 1
  funext n
  simp only [logZetaCoeff, IntegerMassRigidity.lamLog]
  split_ifs <;> simp [Complex.ofReal_div]

/-- Ordinary harmonic convergence after centering at the literal pole residue. -/
theorem exists_centered_forward_harmonic_limit {lam : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) :
    ∃ L : ℂ, Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N,
      (forwardCoeff lam n - WeilWorkSettledPhase.sourceCompletion hW 1) / n)
        atTop (𝓝 L) := by
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := WeilWorkSettledPhase.centered_forward_dirichletConvergesAt
    hW (s := 1) (by norm_num)
  refine ⟨L, hL.congr fun N => ?_⟩
  rw [sum_Icc_one_eq_range]
  simp [dirichletPartialSum, Complex.cpow_neg_one, forwardCoeff_eq_sourceCoeff,
    Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, div_eq_mul_inv]

/-- The harmonic weight has leading coefficient one. -/
theorem tendsto_harmonic_weight_div_log :
    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, (1 : ℝ) / n) / Real.log N)
      atTop (𝓝 1) := by
  have hlog : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => Real.log N) atTop atTop :=
    Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  have ht := (Real.tendsto_harmonic_sub_log.div_atTop hlog).add_const 1
  simp only [zero_add] at ht
  refine ht.congr' ?_
  filter_upwards [hlog.eventually_gt_atTop 0] with N hN
  rw [sum_Icc_one_eq_range]
  have hh : (harmonic N : ℝ) = ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, (1 : ℝ) / (n + 1) := by
    simp [harmonic, one_div]
  rw [hh]
  simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
  field_simp
  ring

private theorem mean_of_centered {f : ℕ → ℝ} {B L : ℝ}
    (h : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, (f n - B) / n)
      atTop (𝓝 L)) :
    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, f n / n) / Real.log N)
      atTop (𝓝 B) := by
  have hlog : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => Real.log N) atTop atTop :=
    Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  have ht := (h.div_atTop hlog).add (tendsto_harmonic_weight_div_log.const_mul B)
  simp only [mul_one, zero_add] at ht
  apply ht.congr
  intro N
  simp only [sub_div, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  rw [← mul_div_assoc, Finset.mul_sum]
  simp only [mul_one_div]
  ring

/-- Both coordinates of the actual logarithmic first mean equal the residue. -/
theorem forwardCoeff_harmonic_mean {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) :
    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, (forwardCoeff lam n).re / n) /
      Real.log N) atTop (𝓝 (WeilWorkSettledPhase.sourceCompletion hW 1).re) ∧
    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, (forwardCoeff lam n).im / n) /
      Real.log N) atTop (𝓝 (WeilWorkSettledPhase.sourceCompletion hW 1).im) := by
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := exists_centered_forward_harmonic_limit hW
  constructor
  · apply mean_of_centered (L := L.re)
    have ht := (Complex.continuous_re.tendsto L).comp hL
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, Complex.re_sum, ← Complex.ofReal_natCast,
      Complex.div_ofReal_re, Complex.sub_re] using ht
  · apply mean_of_centered (L := L.im)
    have ht := (Complex.continuous_im.tendsto L).comp hL
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, Complex.im_sum, ← Complex.ofReal_natCast,
      Complex.div_ofReal_im, Complex.sub_im] using ht

end RHTower.WeilSingularArithmetic

/-!
# One energy constant controls every actual coprime residue

The actual forward log-energy constant bounds all finite prime deletions
simultaneously. The canonical density is retained by masked Cauchy--Schwarz.
No coefficient sign, multiplicativity, or uniform radial remainder is assumed.
-/

open Complex Filter Topology

noncomputable section

namespace RHTower.WeilSingularArithmetic
open WeilWorkSettledPhase

/-- Density of the integers coprime to a positive modulus. -/
def coprimeDensity (Q : ℕ) : ℝ := ∏ p ∈ Q.primeFactors, (1 - (p : ℝ)⁻¹)

theorem coprimeDensity_pos (Q : ℕ) : 0 < coprimeDensity Q := by
  apply Finset.prod_pos
  intro p hp
  have hp1 : 1 < (p : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp).one_lt
  exact sub_pos.mpr (inv_lt_one_of_one_lt₀ hp1)

theorem coprimeDensity_eq_totient_div (Q : ℕ) [NeZero Q] :
    coprimeDensity Q = (Q.totient : ℝ) / Q := by
  have h := congrArg (fun x : ℚ => (x : ℝ)) (Nat.totient_eq_mul_prod_factors Q)
  push_cast at h
  exact (eq_div_iff (by exact_mod_cast (NeZero.ne Q) : (Q : ℝ) ≠ 0)).mpr
    (by simpa only [coprimeDensity, mul_comm] using h.symm)

private theorem mask_sq (Q n : ℕ) :
    ‖(coprimeMask Q n : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 = coprimeMask Q n := by
  unfold coprimeMask
  split_ifs <;> norm_num

private theorem mask_square_summable (Q : ℕ) {s : ℝ} (hs : 1 < s) :
    Summable (fun n : ℕ => ‖(coprimeMask Q n : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 / (n : ℝ) ^ s) := by
  refine (Real.summable_one_div_nat_rpow.mpr hs).of_nonneg_of_le
    (fun n => div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) _)) fun n => ?_
  rw [mask_sq]
  unfold coprimeMask
  split_ifs
  · rfl
  · simp only [zero_div]
    positivity

private theorem mask_square_series (Q : ℕ) {s : ℝ} (hs : 1 < s) :
    (LSeries (coprimePart Q 1) (s : ℂ)).re =
      ∑' n : ℕ, ‖(coprimeMask Q n : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 / (n : ℝ) ^ s := by
  have hm := summable_coprimePart Q
    (LSeriesSummable_one_iff.mpr (show 1 < (s : ℂ).re from hs))
  rw [LSeries, Complex.re_tsum hm]
  apply tsum_congr
  intro n
  rw [mask_sq]
  by_cases hn : n = 0
  · simp [hn, LSeries.term, Real.zero_rpow (by linarith : s ≠ 0)]
  · have he : (n : ℂ) ^ (s : ℂ) = (((n : ℝ) ^ s : ℝ) : ℂ) :=
      (Complex.ofReal_cpow (Nat.cast_nonneg n) s).symm
    simp only [LSeries.term, if_neg hn, coprimePart, Pi.one_apply, mul_one,
      he, ← Complex.ofReal_div,
      Complex.ofReal_re]

/-- The actual radial square density of the coprimality mask. -/
theorem coprime_mask_square_residue (Q : ℕ) [NeZero Q] :
    Tendsto (fun s : ℝ =>
      (s - 1) * ∑' n : ℕ, ‖(coprimeMask Q n : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 / (n : ℝ) ^ s)
      (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 (coprimeDensity Q)) := by
  have hc : Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => ((s : ℂ) - 1) *
      DirichletCharacter.LFunctionTrivChar Q (s : ℂ)) (𝓝[>] 1)
      (𝓝 (coprimeDensity Q : ℂ)) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, coprimeDensity, Complex.ofReal_prod,
      Complex.ofReal_sub, Complex.ofReal_one, Complex.ofReal_inv, Complex.ofReal_natCast] using
      (DirichletCharacter.LFunctionTrivChar_residue_one (N := Q)).comp
        tendsto_ofReal_nhdsWithin_ne_one
  have ht := Complex.continuous_re.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hc
  simp only [Complex.ofReal_re] at ht
  apply ht.congr'
  filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with s hs
  simp only [Function.comp_apply]
  rw [← LSeries_coprimePart_one Q (show 1 < (s : ℂ).re from hs)]
  simp only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.sub_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.one_re,
    Complex.sub_im, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.one_im, sub_self, zero_mul, sub_zero]

radial residue. Full positivity is the only arithmetic premise. -/
theorem exists_forward_coprime_energy {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) :

# A positive finite limit for the actual odd forward ratio

Odd restriction commutes with Dirichlet convolution and its exponential.
The ratio is consequently the exponential of the negative even logarithm.
Its finite radial limit is not assigned the canonical value one half.

open Complex Filter Topology Set

private theorem evenPart_lamLog (lam : ℕ → ℝ) :
    evenPart (lamLog lam) = logZetaCoeff (evenSourceCoeff lam) := by
  funext n
  by_cases hn : 2≤n <;> by_cases he : 2 ∣ n <;>
    simp [evenPart,lamLog,logZetaCoeff,evenSourceCoeff,hn,he]

/-- The literal odd forward series divided by the full forward series is the
exponential of minus the even logarithm. -/
theorem odd_source_ratio_eq {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam)
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 1<σ) :
    LSeries (oddPart (sourceCoeff lam)) (σ : ℂ) / LSeries (sourceCoeff lam) (σ : ℂ) =
      (Real.exp (-sourceEvenLogarithm lam σ) : ℂ) := by
  have hs : 1<(σ : ℂ).re := hσ
  have hl : LSeriesSummable (lamLog lam) (σ : ℂ) :=
    lseriesSummable_of_le (norm_lamLog_le lam)
      (fun _ hσ => WeilMeanSquare.summable_abs_div_rpow_of_weilPositiveFull hW hσ) hs
  have he := (LSeries_dirichletExp
    (show oddPart (lamLog lam) 0=0 by simp [oddPart])
    (show oddPart (lamLog lam) 1=0 by simp [oddPart,lamLog_one]) (summable_oddPart hl)).2
  rw [show oddPart (sourceCoeff lam) = dirichletExp (oddPart (lamLog lam)) from
      oddPart_dirichletExp (lamLog lam),he,oddPart_eq_sub,
    LSeries_sub hl (summable_evenPart hl),evenPart_lamLog,
    ← ofReal_sourceEvenLogarithm hW hσ, (sourceCoeff_LSeries hW hs).2,zetaOf,
    Complex.exp_sub, Complex.ofReal_exp, Complex.ofReal_neg, Complex.exp_neg]
  field_simp [Complex.exp_ne_zero]

/-- The actual odd-to-full forward ratio has a positive finite radial limit,
with an error bounded linearly by the distance to one. -/
theorem exists_odd_source_ratio_limit {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) :
    ∃ r K eta : ℝ, 0<r ∧ 0≤K ∧ 0<eta ∧
      Tendsto (fun σ : ℝ => LSeries (oddPart (sourceCoeff lam)) (σ : ℂ) /
        LSeries (sourceCoeff lam) (σ : ℂ)) (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 (r : ℂ)) ∧
      ∀ σ : ℝ, 1<σ → σ<1+eta →
        ‖LSeries (oddPart (sourceCoeff lam)) (σ : ℂ) /
          LSeries (sourceCoeff lam) (σ : ℂ) - (r : ℂ)‖ ≤ K*(σ-1) := by
  obtain ⟨ell,K,eta,hK,heta,ht,herr⟩ := exists_sourceEvenLogarithm_lipschitz_limit hW
  have ht' := Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousAt.tendsto.comp
    (Real.continuous_exp.continuousAt.tendsto.comp ht.neg)
  have htRatio : Tendsto (fun σ : ℝ => LSeries (oddPart (sourceCoeff lam)) (σ : ℂ) /
        LSeries (sourceCoeff lam) (σ : ℂ)) (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 (Real.exp (-ell) : ℂ)) := by
    apply ht'.congr'
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with σ hσ
    exact (odd_source_ratio_eq hW hσ).symm
  have hnear : ∀ᶠ σ : ℝ in 𝓝[>] 1, |sourceEvenLogarithm lam σ-ell|<1 := by
    simpa only [Real.dist_eq] using (Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp ht) 1 (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨u,hu,hub⟩ := mem_nhdsGT_iff_exists_Ioo_subset.mp hnear
  refine ⟨Real.exp (-ell),2*Real.exp (-ell)*K,min eta (u-1),Real.exp_pos _,
    by positivity,lt_min heta (sub_pos.mpr hu),htRatio,fun σ hσ hσ' => ?_⟩
  have hση : σ<1+eta := by linarith [min_le_left eta (u-1)]
  have hσu : σ<u := by linarith [min_le_right eta (u-1)]
  have hsmall := hub (show σ∈Ioo 1 u from ⟨hσ,hσu⟩)
  rw [odd_source_ratio_eq hW hσ]
  have hn : ‖(-(sourceEvenLogarithm lam σ : ℂ))-(-(ell : ℂ))‖ =
      |sourceEvenLogarithm lam σ-ell| := by
    rw [neg_sub_neg,← Complex.ofReal_sub,Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_sub_comm]
  have h := Complex.locally_lipschitz_exp (r := 1) (by norm_num) le_rfl
    (-(ell : ℂ)) (-(sourceEvenLogarithm lam σ : ℂ)) (by rwa [hn])
  rw [hn] at h
  simp only [← Complex.ofReal_neg,← Complex.ofReal_exp,Complex.norm_real,
    Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)] at h
  calc
    _ ≤ 2*Real.exp (-ell)*|sourceEvenLogarithm lam σ-ell| := by
      convert h using 1
      norm_num
    _ ≤ 2*Real.exp (-ell)*(K*(σ-1)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (herr σ hσ hση) (by positivity)
    _ = _ := by ring

/-!
# Finite logarithm endpoints on every positive valuation class

Each fixed prime-power valuation class of the actual source has a literal
logarithmic Dirichlet series with a finite right limit and a linear remainder.
The endpoint is not assigned a canonical value.
-/

open Complex Filter Topology Set
noncomputable section
namespace RHTower.WeilSingularArithmetic

/-- The literal exact-valuation restriction of the normalized arithmetic source. -/
def valuationSourceCoeff (lam : ℕ → ℝ) (p k : ℕ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  if 2 ≤ n ∧ (p^k ∣ n ∧ ¬p^(k+1) ∣ n) then lam n else 0

private theorem valuationSourceCoeff_cast (lam : ℕ → ℝ) (p k : ℕ) :
    (fun n => (valuationSourceCoeff lam p k n : ℂ)) = valuationPart p k (WeilHerglotz.lamC lam) := by
  funext n
  by_cases hn : 2≤n <;> by_cases he : (p^k ∣ n ∧ ¬p^(k+1) ∣ n) <;>
    simp [valuationSourceCoeff,valuationPart,valuationMask,WeilHerglotz.lamC,hn,he]

private theorem valuationSourceCoeff_summable {lam : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) (p k : ℕ) {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 1<σ) :
    Summable fun n : ℕ => |valuationSourceCoeff lam p k n|/(n : ℝ)^σ := by
  refine (WeilMeanSquare.summable_abs_div_rpow_of_weilPositiveFull hW hσ).of_nonneg_of_le
    (fun _ => by positivity) fun n => ?_
  unfold valuationSourceCoeff
  split_ifs
  · rfl
  · simp only [abs_zero,zero_div]
    positivity

/-- The valuation logarithmic Dirichlet series, evaluated on its actual half-plane
of absolute convergence. -/
def sourceValuationLogarithm (lam : ℕ → ℝ) (p k : ℕ) (σ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (LSeries (logZetaCoeff (valuationSourceCoeff lam p k)) (σ : ℂ)).re

/-- The logarithm is the literal series over the specified valuation class. -/
theorem sourceValuationLogarithm_eq_tsum {lam : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) (p k : ℕ) {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 1<σ) :
    sourceValuationLogarithm lam p k σ = ∑' n : ℕ,
      if 2≤n ∧ (p^k ∣ n ∧ ¬p^(k+1) ∣ n) then lam n/(Real.log n*(n : ℝ)^σ) else 0 := by
  have hs := lseriesSummable_logZetaCoeff
    (fun σ hσ => valuationSourceCoeff_summable hW p k hσ) hσ
  rw [sourceValuationLogarithm,LSeries,Complex.re_tsum hs]
  apply tsum_congr
  intro n
  by_cases hn : n=0
  · subst n
    simp [LSeries.term]
  · have he : (n : ℂ)^(σ : ℂ) = (((n : ℝ)^σ : ℝ) : ℂ) :=
      (Complex.ofReal_cpow (Nat.cast_nonneg n) σ).symm
    by_cases h : 2≤n ∧ (p^k ∣ n ∧ ¬p^(k+1) ∣ n) <;>
      simp [LSeries.term,logZetaCoeff,valuationSourceCoeff,hn,h,he,← Complex.ofReal_div,div_div]

/-- The valuation logarithmic series is real on its real half-line of convergence. -/
theorem ofReal_sourceValuationLogarithm {lam : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) (p k : ℕ) {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 1<σ) :
    (sourceValuationLogarithm lam p k σ : ℂ) =
      LSeries (logZetaCoeff (valuationSourceCoeff lam p k)) (σ : ℂ) := by
  have hs := lseriesSummable_logZetaCoeff
    (fun σ hσ => valuationSourceCoeff_summable hW p k hσ) hσ
  apply Complex.ext
  · rfl
  · simp only [Complex.ofReal_im]
    rw [LSeries,Complex.im_tsum hs]
    symm
    calc
      _ = ∑' _n : ℕ, (0 : ℝ) := by
        apply tsum_congr
        intro n
        by_cases hn : n=0
        · simp [hn,LSeries.term]
        · have he : (n : ℂ)^(σ : ℂ) = (((n : ℝ)^σ : ℝ) : ℂ) :=
            (Complex.ofReal_cpow (Nat.cast_nonneg n) σ).symm
          simp [LSeries.term,logZetaCoeff,hn,he,← Complex.ofReal_div]
      _ = 0 := tsum_zero

private theorem hasDerivAt_sourceValuationLogarithm {lam : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) (p k : ℕ) {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 1<σ) :
    HasDerivAt (sourceValuationLogarithm lam p k)
      (-(LSeries (valuationPart p k (WeilHerglotz.lamC lam)) (σ : ℂ)).re) σ := by
  have hd := hasDerivAt_LSeries_logZetaCoeff
    (fun σ hσ => valuationSourceCoeff_summable hW p k hσ)
    (show valuationSourceCoeff lam p k 1=0 by simp [valuationSourceCoeff]) (s := (σ : ℂ)) hσ
  rw [valuationSourceCoeff_cast] at hd
  exact hd.real_of_complex

/-- Full positivity alone gives a finite right limit of the valuation logarithm,
with a Lipschitz remainder. No value for that limit is prescribed. -/
theorem exists_sourceValuationLogarithm_lipschitz_limit {lam : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ ell K eta : ℝ, 0≤K ∧ 0<eta ∧
      Tendsto (sourceValuationLogarithm lam p (k + 1)) (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 ell) ∧
      ∀ σ : ℝ, 1<σ → σ<1+eta →
      |sourceValuationLogarithm lam p (k + 1) σ-ell|≤K*(σ-1) := by
  obtain ⟨K,hK,hbound⟩ := exists_abs_re_valuation_source_le hW hp k
  obtain ⟨u,hu,hub⟩ := mem_nhdsGT_iff_exists_Ioo_subset.mp hbound
  let C : NNReal := .mk K hK
  have hderiv (σ : ℝ) (hσ : σ∈Ioo 1 u) := hasDerivAt_sourceValuationLogarithm hW p (k + 1) hσ.1
  have hLip : LipschitzOnWith C (sourceValuationLogarithm lam p (k + 1)) (Ioo 1 u) := by
    apply Convex.lipschitzOnWith_of_nnnorm_deriv_le

/-!
# Bounded normalized Mellin values survive finite local differences

Point-mass convolution multiplies a real-axis L-series by a positive scalar at
most one. Applying this twice to the actual source isolates every valuation
class of the logarithmic deviation behind a fixed coprime square factor.
-/

open Complex Set Filter Topology
noncomputable section
namespace RHTower.WeilSingularArithmetic

theorem normalizedCoefficientMellin_point {p : ℕ} (hp : p ≠ 0)
    {f : ℕ → ℂ} {σ : ℝ} (hf : LSeriesSummable f (σ : ℂ)) :
    normalizedCoefficientMellin (LSeries.convolution (dirichletPoint p) f) σ =
      (p : ℝ) ^ (-σ) * normalizedCoefficientMellin f σ := by
  rw [normalizedCoefficientMellin,
    LSeries_convolution' (summable_dirichletPoint p (σ : ℂ)) hf,
    LSeries_dirichletPoint hp]
  have hr : (p : ℂ) ^ (-(σ : ℂ)) = (((p : ℝ) ^ (-σ) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    rw [Complex.ofReal_cpow (Nat.cast_nonneg p)]
    simp only [Complex.ofReal_neg, Complex.ofReal_natCast]
  rw [hr]
  have he : Gammaℝ (σ : ℂ) * ((((p : ℝ) ^ (-σ) : ℝ) : ℂ) * LSeries f (σ : ℂ)) =
      (((p : ℝ) ^ (-σ) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (Gammaℝ (σ : ℂ) * LSeries f (σ : ℂ)) := by ring
  rw [he]
  simp only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, sub_zero,
    normalizedCoefficientMellin]
  ring

theorem boundedNormalizedMellin_point {p : ℕ} (hp : p ≠ 0) {f : ℕ → ℂ}
    (hsf : ∀ σ : ℝ, 1 < σ → LSeriesSummable f (σ : ℂ))
    (hf : BoundedNormalizedMellin f) :
    BoundedNormalizedMellin (LSeries.convolution (dirichletPoint p) f) := by
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hf⟩ := hf
  refine ⟨C, hC, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin, hf] with σ hσ hf
  rw [normalizedCoefficientMellin_point hp (hsf σ hσ), abs_mul,
    abs_of_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg p) _)]
  have hp1 : 1 ≤ (p : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hp
  have hσ1 : 1 < σ := hσ
  have hpow : (p : ℝ) ^ (-σ) ≤ 1 :=
    Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos hp1 (by linarith)
  exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hpow (abs_nonneg _)).trans (by simpa using hf)

theorem summable_primeDifference (p : ℕ) {f : ℕ → ℂ} {s : ℂ}
    (hf : LSeriesSummable f s) : LSeriesSummable (primeDifference p f) s :=
  hf.sub ((summable_dirichletPoint p s).convolution hf)

theorem boundedNormalizedMellin_valuation_primeDifference {p : ℕ} (hp : p ≠ 0)
    {f : ℕ → ℂ} (hsf : ∀ σ : ℝ, 1 < σ → LSeriesSummable f (σ : ℂ))
    (hf : ∀ k : ℕ, BoundedNormalizedMellin (valuationPart p k f)) (k : ℕ) :
    BoundedNormalizedMellin (valuationPart p k (primeDifference p f)) := by
  cases k with
  | zero => simpa only [valuationPart_primeDifference_zero] using hf 0
  | succ k =>
    rw [valuationPart_primeDifference_succ hp]
    exact boundedNormalizedMellin_sub
      (fun σ hσ => summable_valuationPart p (k + 1) (hsf σ hσ))
      (fun σ hσ => (summable_dirichletPoint p (σ : ℂ)).convolution
        (summable_valuationPart p k (hsf σ hσ)))
      (hf (k + 1))
      (boundedNormalizedMellin_point hp
        (fun σ hσ => summable_valuationPart p k (hsf σ hσ)) (hf k))

/-- Full positivity controls each logarithmic-deviation stratum after the
fixed coprime square smoothing. -/
theorem boundedNormalizedMellin_valuation_deviation_square {lam : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (k : ℕ) :
    BoundedNormalizedMellin (LSeries.convolution
      (LSeries.convolution
        (valuationPart p k (WeilHerglotz.lamC lam -
          fun n => (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n : ℂ))) (coprimePart p 1))
      (coprimePart p 1)) := by
  have hs (σ : ℝ) (hσ : 1 < σ) := sourceSquareCoeff_summable hW (s := (σ : ℂ)) hσ
  have h₁ := boundedNormalizedMellin_valuation_primeDifference hp.ne_zero hs
    (boundedNormalizedMellin_valuation_sourceSquare hW hp.ne_zero)
  have h₂ := boundedNormalizedMellin_valuation_primeDifference hp.ne_zero
    (fun σ hσ => summable_primeDifference p (hs σ hσ)) h₁ k
  rw [sourceSquareCoeff, primeDifference_twice_square hp,
    valuationPart_convolution_coprimePart, valuationPart_convolution_coprimePart] at h₂
  exact h₂

/-!
# The local non-archimedean Weil integral as a sum over valuation shells

Appendix II (9)-(10) of

  A. Connes, *Trace formula in noncommutative geometry and the zeros of the Riemann zeta
  function*, arXiv:math/9811068.

The local Weil term at a finite place is `∫_{k_v^*} f(u) |1-u|^{-1} d^*u`.  Off the unit
sphere the ultrametric equality `|1-u| = max(1,|u|)` makes the kernel *constant on each
valuation shell*, equal to `min(1, q^m)` on `|u| = q^{-m}`.  Combining this with the
multiplicative-Haar shell decomposition of `ℚ_p^*` turns the local integral into an explicit
series over `m ∈ ℤ`, which is the local factor `∑_n log p · p^{-n/2}` of the explicit formula.
-/

open MeasureTheory

namespace GaloisForLFunctions.RHTower

noncomputable section

variable (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]

/-- The valuation-unit chart is the explicit forward map `(m,u) ↦ p^m u`. -/
theorem fieldOnePadicValuationUnitContinuousMulEquiv_apply
    (z : Multiplicative ℤ × ℤ_[p]ˣ) :
    fieldOnePadicValuationUnitContinuousMulEquiv p z
      = fieldOnePadicValuationUnitForward p z := rfl

/-- The chart lands on the valuation shell `‖x‖ = p^{-m}`. -/
theorem connes_padic_shell_norm (m : ℤ) (u : ℤ_[p]ˣ) :
    ‖((fieldOnePadicValuationUnitContinuousMulEquiv p
        (Multiplicative.ofAdd m, u) : ℚ_[p]ˣ) : ℚ_[p])‖ = (p : ℝ) ^ (-m) := by
  have h0 : ((fieldOnePadicValuationUnitContinuousMulEquiv p
      (Multiplicative.ofAdd m, u) : ℚ_[p]ˣ) : ℚ_[p]) ≠ 0 := Units.ne_zero _
  rw [Padic.norm_eq_zpow_neg_valuation h0]
  congr 1
  rw [fieldOnePadicValuationUnitContinuousMulEquiv_apply]
  simpa using fieldOnePadic_valuation_forward p (Multiplicative.ofAdd m, u)

/-- **The Weil kernel is constant on every non-unit shell.** -/
theorem connes_padic_weilKernel_chart {m : ℤ} (hm : m ≠ 0) (u : ℤ_[p]ˣ) :
    ‖1 - ((fieldOnePadicValuationUnitContinuousMulEquiv p
        (Multiplicative.ofAdd m, u) : ℚ_[p]ˣ) : ℚ_[p])‖⁻¹ = min 1 ((p : ℝ) ^ m) :=
  connes_padic_weilKernel_shell hm (connes_padic_shell_norm p m u)

/-- **Integrability of the Weil-weighted one-shell function.** -/
theorem connes_padic_weil_integrable_singleShell
    (f : ℚ_[p]ˣ → ℂ) {m : ℤ} (hm : m ≠ 0) (g : ℤ_[p]ˣ → ℂ)
    (hg : Integrable g (fieldOnePadicUnitNormalizedHaar p))
    (hcoord : ∀ (k : ℤ) (u : ℤ_[p]ˣ),
      f (fieldOnePadicValuationUnitContinuousMulEquiv p
        (Multiplicative.ofAdd k, u)) = if k = m then g u else 0) :
    Integrable (fun a : ℚ_[p]ˣ => f a * ((‖1 - (a : ℚ_[p])‖⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ))
      (fieldOnePadicMultiplicativeHaar p) := by
  refine integrable_fieldOnePadicMultiplicativeHaar_of_singleShell p _ m
    (fun u => ((min 1 ((p : ℝ) ^ m) : ℝ) : ℂ) * g u) (hg.const_mul _) ?_
  intro k u
  by_cases hk : k = m
  · subst hk
    rw [hcoord k u, if_pos rfl, if_pos rfl, connes_padic_weilKernel_chart p hm u, mul_comm]
  · rw [hcoord k u, if_neg hk, if_neg hk, zero_mul]

/-- **Appendix II (9)/(10).**  The local Weil integral of a function carried by the single
valuation shell `‖u‖ = p^{-m}`, `m ≠ 0`, is the angular mass scaled by `min(1, p^m)`. -/
theorem connes_padic_weil_singleShell
    (f : ℚ_[p]ˣ → ℂ) {m : ℤ} (hm : m ≠ 0) (g : ℤ_[p]ˣ → ℂ)
    (hg : Integrable g (fieldOnePadicUnitNormalizedHaar p))
    (hcoord : ∀ (k : ℤ) (u : ℤ_[p]ˣ),
      f (fieldOnePadicValuationUnitContinuousMulEquiv p
        (Multiplicative.ofAdd k, u)) = if k = m then g u else 0) :
    ∫ a, f a * ((‖1 - (a : ℚ_[p])‖⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) ∂fieldOnePadicMultiplicativeHaar p
      = ((min 1 ((p : ℝ) ^ m) : ℝ) : ℂ) * ∫ u, g u ∂fieldOnePadicUnitNormalizedHaar p := by
  have hshell := fieldOnePadicMultiplicativeHaar_integral_singleShell p
    (fun a : ℚ_[p]ˣ => f a * ((‖1 - (a : ℚ_[p])‖⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ)) m
    (fun u => ((min 1 ((p : ℝ) ^ m) : ℝ) : ℂ) * g u) (hg.const_mul _) ?_
  · rw [hshell, integral_const_mul]
  · intro k u
    by_cases hk : k = m
    · subst hk

/-!
# Literal finite-period realization of local polynomial valuation weights

Nested divisibility partitions the coefficient sequence into exact valuation
classes. Counting each class over a complete period gives its geometric weight.
-/

open Polynomial Finset
noncomputable section
namespace RHTower.WeilSingularArithmetic

def localPolynomialCoefficientUpTo (p : ℕ) (P : Polynomial ℝ) (D n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ j ∈ range (D + 1), if p ^ j ∣ n then P.coeff j else 0

theorem localPolynomialCoefficientUpTo_periodic (p : ℕ) (P : Polynomial ℝ) (D : ℕ) :
    Function.Periodic (localPolynomialCoefficientUpTo p P D) (p ^ D) := by
  intro n
  unfold localPolynomialCoefficientUpTo
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  have hper : p ^ j ∣ p ^ D := Nat.pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (mem_range.mp hj))
  have hd : p ^ j ∣ n + p ^ D ↔ p ^ j ∣ n := by
    simpa only [Nat.add_comm] using Nat.dvd_add_right hper
  simp only [hd]

theorem localPolynomialCoefficientUpTo_eq_prefix (p : ℕ) (P : Polynomial ℝ)
    (D n : ℕ) (hd : p ^ D ∣ n) :
    localPolynomialCoefficientUpTo p P D n = localPolynomialPrefix P D := by
  unfold localPolynomialCoefficientUpTo localPolynomialPrefix
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  exact if_pos ((Nat.pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (mem_range.mp hj))).trans hd)

/-- Exact valuation partition, before any averaging or asymptotic limit. -/
theorem localPolynomial_valuation_partition (p : ℕ) (P : Polynomial ℝ)
    (F : ℝ → ℝ) (D n : ℕ) :
    F (localPolynomialCoefficientUpTo p P D n) =
      (∑ k ∈ range D, ((if p ^ k ∣ n then (1 : ℝ) else 0) -
        (if p ^ (k + 1) ∣ n then 1 else 0)) * F (localPolynomialPrefix P k)) +
      (if p ^ D ∣ n then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * F (localPolynomialPrefix P D) := by
  induction D with
  | zero => simp [localPolynomialCoefficientUpTo, localPolynomialPrefix]
  | succ D ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]
    by_cases hd : p ^ (D + 1) ∣ n
    · have hd0 : p ^ D ∣ n := (Nat.pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.le_succ D)).trans hd
      rw [localPolynomialCoefficientUpTo_eq_prefix p P (D + 1) n hd,
        if_pos hd0, if_pos hd]
      rw [localPolynomialCoefficientUpTo_eq_prefix p P D n hd0, if_pos hd0] at ih
      simp only [sub_self, zero_mul, add_zero, one_mul]
      simp only [one_mul] at ih
      linarith only [ih]
    · have he : localPolynomialCoefficientUpTo p P (D + 1) n =
          localPolynomialCoefficientUpTo p P D n := by
        simp only [localPolynomialCoefficientUpTo, Finset.sum_range_succ, if_neg hd, add_zero]
      rw [he, ih, if_neg hd]
      ring

/-- The mean of a power-divisibility indicator over an exact full period. -/
theorem localPolynomial_period_mask_mean (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) (D k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ D) :
    (∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 (p ^ D), if p ^ k ∣ n then (1 : ℝ) else 0) / (p : ℝ) ^ D =
      ((p : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ := by
  rw [Finset.sum_boole, Nat.Ioc_filter_dvd_card_eq_div,
    Nat.cast_div_charZero (Nat.pow_dvd_pow p hk)]
  push_cast
  have hp0 : (p : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hp.ne'
  field_simp

def localPolynomialPeriodAverage (p D : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 (p ^ D), f n) / (p : ℝ) ^ D

/-- Every observable of the literal coefficient has the exact valuation weights. -/
theorem localPolynomial_period_average (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) (P : Polynomial ℝ)
    (F : ℝ → ℝ) (D : ℕ) :
    localPolynomialPeriodAverage p D (fun n => F (localPolynomialCoefficientUpTo p P D n)) =
      (1 - (p : ℝ)⁻¹) * (∑ k ∈ range D, ((p : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ * F (localPolynomialPrefix P k)) +
        ((p : ℝ) ^ D)⁻¹ * F (localPolynomialPrefix P D) := by
  let M (k : ℕ) : ℝ :=
    (∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 (p ^ D), if p ^ k ∣ n then (1 : ℝ) else 0) / (p : ℝ) ^ D
  have hm (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ D) : M k = ((p : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹ :=
    localPolynomial_period_mask_mean p hp D k hk
  have he : localPolynomialPeriodAverage p D
      (fun n => F (localPolynomialCoefficientUpTo p P D n)) =
      (∑ k ∈ range D, (M k - M (k + 1)) * F (localPolynomialPrefix P k)) +
        M D * F (localPolynomialPrefix P D) := by
    unfold localPolynomialPeriodAverage
    simp_rw [localPolynomial_valuation_partition]
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_comm, add_div, div_eq_mul_inv, Finset.sum_mul]
    apply congrArg₂ (· + ·)
    · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro k _
      rw [← Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      dsimp [M]
      ring
    · rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
      dsimp [M]
      ring
  rw [he, hm D le_rfl, Finset.mul_sum]
  refine congrArg₂ (· + ·) ?_ rfl
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k hk
  rw [hm k (Nat.le_of_lt (mem_range.mp hk)), hm (k + 1) (Nat.succ_le_of_lt (mem_range.mp hk)),
    pow_succ, mul_inv]
  ring

/-!
# Bounded actual logarithmic deviation on every fixed valuation class

The coprime square has a positive normalized residue. Dividing the finite local
difference bound by that weight controls the real logarithmic deviation.
-/

open Complex Filter Topology
noncomputable section
namespace RHTower.WeilSingularArithmetic

def sourceValuationDeviation (lam : ℕ → ℝ) (p k : ℕ) (s : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  LSeries (valuationPart p k
    (WeilHerglotz.lamC lam - fun n => (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n : ℂ))) s

private theorem sourceValuationDeviation_im (lam : ℕ → ℝ) (p k : ℕ) (σ : ℝ) :
    (sourceValuationDeviation lam p k (σ : ℂ)).im = 0 := by
  let f : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => valuationMask p k n *
    ((if 2 ≤ n then lam n else 0) - ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n)
  have he : sourceValuationDeviation lam p k (σ : ℂ) =
      ((∑' n : ℕ, if n = 0 then 0 else f n / (n : ℝ) ^ σ : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    unfold sourceValuationDeviation LSeries
    rw [Complex.ofReal_tsum]
    apply tsum_congr
    intro n
    by_cases hn : n = 0
    · simp only [LSeries.term, hn, if_true, Complex.ofReal_zero]
    · simp only [LSeries.term, if_neg hn, valuationPart, Pi.sub_apply, WeilHerglotz.lamC, f,
        Complex.ofReal_div, Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_sub,
        Complex.ofReal_cpow (Nat.cast_nonneg n), Complex.ofReal_natCast]
  rw [he]
  exact Complex.ofReal_im _

private def residue (Q : ℕ) : ℝ := ∏ p ∈ Q.primeFactors, (1 - (p : ℝ)⁻¹)

private theorem residue_pos (Q : ℕ) : 0 < residue Q := by
  apply Finset.prod_pos
  intro p hp
  have hp1 : 1 < (p : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp).one_lt
  have hp0 : 0 < (p : ℝ) := lt_trans zero_lt_one hp1
  apply sub_pos.mpr
  simpa only [one_div] using (div_lt_one hp0).mpr hp1

private def weight (Q : ℕ) [NeZero Q] (σ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (Gammaℝ (σ : ℂ) * (((σ : ℂ) - 1) * DirichletCharacter.LFunctionTrivChar Q (σ : ℂ)) ^ 2).re

private theorem tendsto_weight (Q : ℕ) [NeZero Q] :
    Tendsto (weight Q) (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 (residue Q ^ 2)) := by
  have hres : Tendsto (fun σ : ℝ => ((σ : ℂ) - 1) *
      DirichletCharacter.LFunctionTrivChar Q (σ : ℂ)) (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 (residue Q : ℂ)) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, residue, Complex.ofReal_prod, Complex.ofReal_sub,
      Complex.ofReal_one, Complex.ofReal_inv, Complex.ofReal_natCast] using
      (DirichletCharacter.LFunctionTrivChar_residue_one (N := Q)).comp
        tendsto_ofReal_nhdsWithin_ne_one
  have hg0 : ContinuousAt (fun s : ℂ => (Gammaℝ s)⁻¹) 1 :=
    Complex.differentiable_Gammaℝ_inv.continuous.continuousAt
  have hg1 : ContinuousAt Gammaℝ (1 : ℂ) := by
    have hi := hg0.inv₀ (by simp : (Gammaℝ 1)⁻¹ ≠ 0)
    change ContinuousAt (fun s : ℂ => ((Gammaℝ s)⁻¹)⁻¹) 1 at hi
    simpa only [inv_inv] using hi
  have hg : Tendsto (fun σ : ℝ => Gammaℝ (σ : ℂ)) (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 1) := by
    simpa only [Complex.Gammaℝ_one, Function.comp_def] using hg1.tendsto.comp
      (tendsto_ofReal_nhdsWithin_ne_one.mono_right nhdsWithin_le_nhds)
  have h := (Complex.continuous_re.tendsto _).comp (hg.mul (hres.pow 2))
  change Tendsto (fun σ : ℝ => (Gammaℝ (σ : ℂ) *
    (((σ : ℂ) - 1) * DirichletCharacter.LFunctionTrivChar Q (σ : ℂ)) ^ 2).re) _ _
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, one_mul, ← Complex.ofReal_pow, Complex.ofReal_re] using h

private theorem normalized_valuation_square_eq {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam)
    (p k : ℕ) [NeZero p] {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 1 < σ) :
    normalizedCoefficientMellin (LSeries.convolution
      (LSeries.convolution (valuationPart p k (WeilHerglotz.lamC lam -
        fun n => (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n : ℂ))) (coprimePart p 1))
      (coprimePart p 1)) σ = weight p σ * (sourceValuationDeviation lam p k (σ : ℂ)).re := by
  have hd0 : LSeriesSummable
      (WeilHerglotz.lamC lam - fun n => (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n : ℂ)) (σ : ℂ) :=
    LSeriesSummable.sub (WeilHerglotz.summable_term_lamC hW (s := (σ : ℂ)) hσ)
      (ArithmeticFunction.LSeriesSummable_vonMangoldt (s := (σ : ℂ)) hσ)
  have hd : LSeriesSummable (valuationPart p k
      (WeilHerglotz.lamC lam - fun n => (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n : ℂ))) (σ : ℂ) :=
    summable_valuationPart p k hd0
  have hu : LSeriesSummable (coprimePart p 1) (σ : ℂ) :=
    summable_coprimePart p (LSeriesSummable_one_iff.mpr (show 1 < (σ : ℂ).re from hσ))
  rw [normalizedCoefficientMellin, LSeries_convolution' (hd.convolution hu) hu,
    LSeries_convolution' hd hu, LSeries_coprimePart_one p hσ]
  change (σ - 1) ^ 2 * (Gammaℝ (σ : ℂ) *
    (sourceValuationDeviation lam p k (σ : ℂ) * _ * _)).re = _
  have he : (((σ - 1) ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * (Gammaℝ (σ : ℂ) *
      (sourceValuationDeviation lam p k (σ : ℂ) *
        DirichletCharacter.LFunctionTrivChar p (σ : ℂ) *
        DirichletCharacter.LFunctionTrivChar p (σ : ℂ))) =
      (Gammaℝ (σ : ℂ) * (((σ : ℂ) - 1) *
        DirichletCharacter.LFunctionTrivChar p (σ : ℂ)) ^ 2) *
          sourceValuationDeviation lam p k (σ : ℂ) := by
    push_cast
